newsitem.title: USA: Securities panel to study soft dollar practices.
newsitem.headline: Securities panel to study soft dollar practices.

text.p: Securities Industry Association said Thursday it has formed a panel to study the practice of commissions being used to pay for brokerage and research services known as "soft dollar arrangements."
The panel will also focus on setting up guidelines for broker-dealers and promoting discussions between the brokerage community and regulatory agencies, the industry group said.

"This panel will use its expertise to develop recommendations that will be aspirational in nature, and that firms may adopt, reject or modify according to their needs," panel chairman Howard Schwartz said in a statement.
The panel met with senior Securities and Exchange Commission staff on June 5.
"We outlined for them our concepts for developing the best practice guidelines and exchanged ideas," said Schwartz, chairman and chief executive officer of Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc.
